parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter rules for the component.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The parameter name of the filter.

sub_parameters.name: Operator
sub_parameters.description: The comparison operator that is used to filter property values.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The parameter values of the filter.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.
